name: Keystep EU VAT Suite for WooCommerce
author: shasan7774

sections.description:
Keystep EU VAT Suite makes your WooCommerce store charge the correct EU VAT on every order, automatically.

  • Correct destination VAT for B2C customers across all 27 EU member states, based on the customer’s billing country.
  • B2B reverse-charge — EU business VAT numbers are validated against the official VIES service and zero-rated when valid.
  • Resilient at checkout — if the VIES service is slow or unavailable, checkout still completes: the order is charged standard VAT and flagged for your review, so a sale is never lost and an unverified number is never silently zero-rated.
  • Block and classic checkout — the VAT-number field is registered through WooCommerce’s Additional Checkout Fields API, so it appears in both.
  • HPOS-compatible — works with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.
  • Coexists with your tax setup — it adds the EU standard rates that are missing and never overwrites rates you have already configured. Reduced-rate products use WooCommerce’s own Reduced-rate tax class, which you configure.

This plugin is a calculation and compliance tool. You remain responsible for your own VAT registration and filings.

Pro add-on

OSS return reporting, the EUR 10,000 distance-selling threshold tracker, and audit CSV export are available in a separate Keystep EU VAT Suite Pro add-on, distributed from https://shasan7774.github.io/eu-vat-suite/ and not hosted on WordPress.org. The free plugin above is fully functional on its own.

External services

To apply B2B reverse-charge correctly, this plugin validates EU business VAT numbers against VIES (the VAT Information Exchange System), an official service operated by the European Commission.

  • When it is called: only when a customer enters a VAT number at checkout. Results are cached to minimise repeat calls, and the service is never contacted for consumer (B2C) orders.
  • What is sent: the VAT number the customer enters, together with its two-letter country code. No name, address, order contents, or other personal data is transmitted.
  • Why: to confirm the VAT number is genuine so a valid EU business can be correctly zero-rated under the reverse-charge rules.
  • Provider: European Commission — VIES. Service, terms and legal/disclaimer information: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/

The plugin contacts no other third-party services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to wp-content/plugins/ (or install via the Plugins screen) and activate it. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. In WooCommerce > Settings > General, make sure “Enable tax rates and calculations” is on. The plugin will prompt you if it is off.
  3. The plugin imports the current EU standard VAT rates into your WooCommerce tax tables on activation. You can re-import any time from WooCommerce > Settings > Tax > Keystep EU VAT Suite.
  4. Done — correct EU VAT is applied at checkout.
sections.faq:
What happens if VIES is down during checkout?

Checkout still completes. Rather than breaking the page or wrongly zero-rating an unverified business, the plugin charges standard VAT and flags the order for your review, so you never lose a sale and never under-collect.

Does it support the block-based checkout?

Yes. The VAT-number field is registered through WooCommerce’s Additional Checkout Fields API, so it appears in both the block checkout and the classic checkout.

What about reduced-rate products (books, food, etc.)?

The plugin manages the EU standard rates automatically. For reduced-rate items, assign them to WooCommerce’s built-in “Reduced rate” tax class and set the rate there — the plugin never touches rates you’ve configured yourself.

Does it change my store settings automatically?

No. It imports EU VAT rates (which is its job), but it never silently changes your currency, country, or tax status. If tax calculation is off, it shows a notice asking you to enable it — your choice.

When do I need OSS and the EUR 10,000 threshold?

If your total cross-border B2C sales to other EU countries stay under EUR 10,000 per year, you may charge your home country’s VAT rate. Once you pass EUR 10,000 — counted across all EU countries combined, not per country — you must charge each customer’s destination VAT rate and report it through the EU One-Stop-Shop (OSS) return. This free plugin applies the correct destination rates automatically. The separate Keystep EU VAT Suite Pro add-on adds a threshold tracker and a ready-made OSS report so you can see when you cross the line and file.

Is this tax advice?

No. Keystep EU VAT Suite is a calculation and compliance tool. You remain responsible for your own VAT registration and filings.
